scripts.compact: node ../../../../tooling/scripts/ensure-compact-package-aliases.mjs && node ../../../../tooling/scripts/ensure-compact-artifacts.mjs --manifest src/managed/.compact-artifact.json --source-root src --output src/managed/same-holder --recipe-input scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs -- sh -c "compact compile src/same-holder.compact src/managed/same-holder && node ./scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs"
scripts.pretest: pnpm --dir ../../primitives/credentials run build && pnpm run compact
scripts.pretest:ci: pnpm --dir ../../primitives/credentials run build && pnpm run compact
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -rf coverage && rm -rf reports && rm -rf src/managed
scripts.build: pnpm run compact && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --force && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/ && rm -f ./dist/managed/.compact-artifact.json && cp ./src/same-holder.compact ./dist && cp -Rf ./src/same-holder ./dist/
scripts.all: pnpm run compact && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:ci
